blurb: Arroyo Seco Stables offers horse boarding with caring staff who have decades of experience. Facility amenities include a full-size arena, a practice arena, a separate turn-out, and direct access to miles of trails along the Arroyo Seco. Horses are fed twice daily, and stalls/corrals are cleaned 6 days a week. Additional services such as blanketing and turn-out can be arranged for an extra fee.
